what.text: This page follows refugees from South Sudan living in Uganda.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1033579 South Sudanese refugees in Uganda, 43.3% of all South Sudanese refugees and more than in any other host country.
Sudan and Ethiopia host the next largest numbers.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of South Sudan from 2011 to 2021 and again in 2025, at war level in 2014.
The groups fighting the government include the SPLM/A - IO, which UCDP also lists in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Uganda rose from 11135 in 2012 to a peak of 1037412 in 2017.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025, and the figure has stayed close to its peak since then.
Returns from Uganda to South Sudan were highest in 2021 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Uganda only.
People displaced inside South Sudan are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Uganda they live.
